objective: Study and solve a general daytime single-image dehazing problem: repeatable, measurable, and intervenable spatial heterogeneity in bidirectional local restoration error, including under-restoration, over-restoration, and damage to already-clear or nearly clear regions. Qualify observable signals that estimate the direction and strength of local restoration adjustment without ground truth at inference, then develop an end-to-end trainable mechanism inside the model graph that can increase, decrease, or preserve local restoration as needed. Fidelity-constrained feature modulation is the primary candidate mechanism, not a mandatory or exclusive parameterization; evidence may support another internal trainable implementation, but never post-processing. ConvIR-B is only the reproducible baseline, initialization, and matched comparison, while every scientific claim concerns a dehazing-domain problem. Final success requires stable improvement over matched ConvIR-B on predeclared standard dehazing quality metrics, preservation of nearly clear regions, controlled tail risk, and independent cross-domain evidence. The program must form a defensible master's-thesis research loop within five months, using CCF B review quality as the design bar through mechanistic explanation, sufficient ablation, valid uncertainty, and independent confirmation, without weakening scientific gates to meet the schedule. Every candidate must progress through program-local training, development, confirmation, and one-use sealed-final evidence without inheriting historical route outcomes, exposure labels, decisions, or authorizations.

dataset_contract_foundation.core_assumption: Outcome-blind clear-scene identity, exact-content grouping, known-overlap quarantine, and deterministic program-local role assignment can create a usable evidence contract without inheriting any historical scientific conclusion or exposure label.
dataset_contract_foundation.close_condition: Close after one typed S0 terminal establishes whether the initial dataset scope can support authoring the S1 utility-qualification contract.

local_restoration_need_qualification.core_assumption: Daytime dehazing exhibits scene-grouped, repeatable, spatially heterogeneous bidirectional local restoration error: different regions may require stronger restoration, weaker restoration, or preservation, including under-restoration, over-restoration, and damage to already-clear or nearly clear regions. This structure is materially stronger than measurement noise and simple global difficulty variation.
local_restoration_need_qualification.close_condition: Close when the frozen utility and repeatability gates decide whether the target dehazing failure mode is a viable research problem.

observable_need_estimation.core_assumption: Observable internal or image-derived signals can predict the direction and strength of local restoration adjustment well enough to support a trainable non-privileged mechanism without using ground truth at inference time.
observable_need_estimation.close_condition: Close when observable-signal qualification either supports one frozen mechanism interface or rejects the family core assumption.

internal_adaptive_restoration.core_assumption: An end-to-end trainable internal adaptive-restoration mechanism can allocate restoration strength spatially while preserving already-clear or nearly clear regions and improving predeclared standard dehazing metrics over matched ConvIR-B without post-processing. Fidelity-constrained feature modulation is the primary candidate, while other internal parameterizations remain eligible only if they solve the same bidirectional local-error problem under the same evidence gates.
internal_adaptive_restoration.close_condition: Close after the adjacent module budget yields one frozen candidate meeting utility, preservation, stability, and ablation gates or rejects the family assumption.

frozen_candidate_confirmation.core_assumption: One fully frozen candidate selected without confirmation access retains its predeclared standard-metric gains, nearly-clear-region preservation, and tail-risk behavior on independent confirmation scenes and domains.
frozen_candidate_confirmation.close_condition: Close after the single frozen-candidate confirmation terminal; confirmation outcomes cannot be used to tune or reopen the same candidate.

sealed_final_evaluation.core_assumption: The completely frozen method generalizes to the one-use sealed-final evidence and supports the final daytime dehazing claim under predeclared standard quality metrics, preservation and tail-risk criteria, cross-domain analysis, and valid uncertainty.
sealed_final_evaluation.close_condition: Close permanently after the single sealed-final access and final typed terminal; sealed outcomes never authorize tuning or reopening.
